metadata.description: Synthesize a 440 Hz tone with ffmpeg, then transcribe it with OpenAI Whisper through its Python API. Neither ffmpeg nor whisper ships in the base image - see README 'Media toolkit layer'.

command: import json, sys, whisper; model = whisper.load_model('base'); result = model.transcribe(sys.argv[1]); json.dump(result, open(sys.argv[2], 'w', encoding='utf-8'), default=str)
